answer: Quartz-anchor work-slot bond: each identity locks 70 credits on a mesa slot. Each epoch one quartz crate runs through the slot with a key-signed count. An anchor inspector recounts one crate in eight; a reused serial or shared slot burns the deposit. Fees run 34+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,031,000 for a 40,000 pool. A rented-slot ring burns: rented crates bear the owner's quartz seal. An honest mesa worker pays 34 once and recovers the deposit.
